'''2000 Toola Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Toola region (Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="rl00toola">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=toola 2000 Regionals: Toola], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010728171432/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=toola Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 1 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Dragons Den c/o Elsas Hus, Linköping, Sweden

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Martin Akesson writes that Jesper Larsson, 'the Swedish regional qualifier', beat him by three force in the regional final; the hub notes that Decipher's regionals listing names Bert-Olof Lundin while the DecipherCon 2000 qualifier list names Larsson.<ref name="tr-d1133" />
